# Phase 5 site-move fixture pack

All executable documents and field values in this directory are fictional and
synthetic. They are regression fixtures, not AICTE forms or evidence of an
approval. The Format-2/Format-3 field layout and comparison paths remain
unverified placeholders pending the PRD §19 source/template questions.

The PRD requires a public EoA letter to serve as the demo master record. The
public source pointer is recorded as `SRC-EOA-PUBLIC-REFERENCE` in
`docs/SOURCES.md`; the institution's PDF is deliberately not copied into this
repository. The JSON `eoa_master_record.json` is synthetic test data and must
not be represented as that public letter.
